The m=1 factorization D0=x²(3−x)/36 and Chebyshev zeros enumerate exactly 2^s distinct positives, all false phase certificates by algebraicity and transcendence of pi. 11,669 exact-rational/high-precision checker assertions replayed. Floating-point tests do not substitute for infinite proof.

value.rationale: A zero oscillator energy defect is a tempting but insufficient diagnostic of matrix-function accuracy. This provides a complete natural degree-one false-certificate classification and an all-fixed-degree scaling law achieving the largest possible phase error despite vanishing seed truncation error. The result clarifies why energy checks cannot replace propagated forward-error control; not framed as failure of adaptive certified parameter selection.
